messages:
Nora (DevEx): FYI small onboarding blocker: our monorepo example breaks only on Vercel Edge when the js sdk is a pnpm workspace symlink. Build error: \"Package subpath './edge' is not defined by \"exports\" in /workspace/packages/js-sdk/package.json\".

Nora (DevEx): Repro: pnpm install -> cd examples/edge-playground -> pnpm dev (vercel dev) -> import RedwoodClient from 'js-sdk' -> dev build fails during resolve.

Diego: Is this a runtime or resolve-time error?

Nora (DevEx): Resolve/build-time (esbuild/rollup). Snippet: ```
Error: Package subpath './edge' is not defined by "exports" in /workspace/packages/js-sdk/package.json
    at Object.resolve (/snapshot/rollup/node_modules/resolve/lib/async.js:...)
```

Mina: Quick root-cause: bundler tried to pull a subpath (./edge) but package.json doesn't expose it. Also TS in the example can't see types when the package is hoisted; adding a top-level "types" helps.

Nora (DevEx): Workarounds that worked locally: (a) npm pack + install tarball, (b) add a tiny local shim package that re-exports dist/index.mjs, or (c) publish a patch with ./edge export. For docs, recommend the shim until we ship a fix.

Mina: Action plan on SDK: add an explicit ./edge export pointing to dist/edge/index.mjs, add "module" and "browser" fields, and set "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" at package root so TS resolves when hoisted. Example patch: ```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
      "edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "module": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "browser": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```

Nora (DevEx): Separate but related: observed a 401/retry loop on Edge when fetch retries overlap with our token refresh. Logs: ```
[edge] POST /v1/predict -> 401
[edge] refreshToken() started (req A)
[edge] runtime retry fires (req B) -> 401 -> triggers refreshToken() (req B)
[edge] race ends poorly, repeated 401s
```

Diego: Implement single-flight refresh (share in-flight promise) and tag retries to avoid triggering refresh while a refresh is in progress. Also ensure retries pick up the new token once resolved.

Mina: I'll open a PR for the exports/types changes. Diego, can you own single-flight refresh + add a small edge test simulating double retry?

CI Bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/513 and branch fix/edge-exports-513

Nora (DevEx): Adding repro dir to the issue and marking as onboarding-blocker. Leaving a short troubleshooting note in docs about pnpm symlink + bundler quirks. Thanks :thumbsup:
